about: Have a UAE-issued document attested by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for use abroad.
note: Requirements read from the official MOFA service page on the checked date. MOFA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Document attestation. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Digital attestation covers UAE-issued original digital documents with a QR code, barcode or reference number
Courier attestation is for documents that do not qualify for digital attestation
Commercial invoices and certificates of origin go through the separate eDAS system
documents: Digital: the original digital PDF, not scanned, photographed or password protected
Courier: original document in Arabic or English or with a legal translation, not laminated, and already attested by the competent authorities
Up to five documents per application, all using the same method
fees: Fee depends on number of documents, completion option and personal or commercial use; see the Attestation Guide
timing: Digital inside the UAE within 2 hours in working hours
Courier inside the UAE 1 to 3 business days
Courier outside the UAE up to 7 business days
channels: MOFA website and UAE MOFA app, sign in with UAE PASS
